_doc: SPECIFICATIONS SD-39 allow-list for what ships (server image closure, web bundles, iPhone bundle). shippedRoots is the server and web closure by pnpm --prod; the iPhone app ships what Metro bundles (bundleApp), derived by an offline expo export; iosRoots is the native production closure for the HC-07 gate. Read by ci/license-gates.ts. Widening this list is an owner decision, never a lane's fix for a red gate.

OFL-1.1._doc: Font files only: allowed on a shipped package whose name matches one of these patterns.

ODbL-1.0._doc: Map data, tracks and the street list only: allowed on a shipped package named here.

CC-BY-4.0._doc: F-245: browser-support data only: allowed on a shipped package named here. Attribution is required; the credit is recorded here.

LGPL-3.0-or-later._doc: Owner ruling 0963dc1d (answered Nov 10, 2026, 1:11 AM EST: 'Allow LGPL for libvips'; plan 0.26 section 11 item 25; F-1263): the libvips binary sharp loads for the photo small copy (SPECIFICATIONS SD-32), on the server only: allowed on a server-closure package whose name matches one of these patterns, never in the iPhone app (HC-07, FR-DIST-6: ios-bundle-copyleft still fails any GPL, LGPL or AGPL there, and so does license-inventory for a package in the iPhone bundle).
